data.title: Oklahoma Bitcoin mining site condemned after leaking 3 million gallons of water during drought
data.description: A Bitcoin mining facility in El Reno, Oklahoma, leaked roughly 3 to 3.8 million gallons of water into the ground while the surrounding region baked under a severe drought.
